title: Match variants carrying different payloads
summary: Destructure tuple and record variants, borrow an enum to keep it usable and cover an idle variant explicitly.

definition.clue: Keyword defining a type with distinct variants

reference.clue: Shared reference type allowing amount to inspect reading without consuming its String

branch.clue: Exhaustive branching keyword for enum variants

idle.clue: Reading variant carrying no payload, mapped to zero

tuple.clue: Reading tuple variant carrying one numeric value

dereference.clue: Operator reading the u32 through its shared reference in the Count arm

record.clue: Reading variant with named name and value fields

rest.clue: Pattern syntax ignoring the remaining named fields

conditional.clue: Conditional pattern construct inspecting only the Named case

equal.clue: Macro checking the idle reading’s amount
